clips.title: The story
paras: Across Dun Morogh, wendigo manes are gathered from the beasts roaming its frozen crags. Their thick coats offer warmth against the mountain cold, and Pilot Stonegear has a use for them.

Dun Morogh’s wendigos roam the snowdrifts, and their coarse fur shields against bitter drafts. Pilot Stonegear, stationed outside Kharanos, sends adventurers to Grizzled Den for their heavy manes. He plans to weave them into an insulating floor rug for the interior deck of his prized dwarven siege engine, Trollplow.
